scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: node init && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
